name: Login
desc: Verify user authentication with valid/invalid email and password, check input validation, inactive account restrictions, and JWT token issuance.
pre: User has a registered account in the system

test_cases.desc: Login successfully with valid Owner account credentials
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Login page (/login) or click 'Đăng nhập'.
2. Enter valid registered Owner email.
3. Enter valid password.
4. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Authentication succeeds; JWT access token saved, HttpOnly refresh cookie set; user is redirected to Owner Dashboard (/owner/dashboard).
test_cases.pre: Owner account exists and is active (isActive = true)

test_cases.desc: Login successfully with valid Tenant account credentials
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Login modal.
2. Enter valid registered Tenant email and password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Authentication succeeds; user redirected to Tenant Dashboard (/tenant/dashboard); tenant session initialized.
test_cases.pre: Tenant account exists and is active

test_cases.desc: Login successfully with valid Staff account credentials
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Login form.
2. Enter valid Staff email and password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Authentication succeeds; user redirected to Staff Dashboard (/staff/dashboard) with warehouse operator permissions.
test_cases.pre: Staff account exists and accepted invitation

test_cases.desc: Login successfully with valid Admin account credentials
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Login form.
2. Enter valid Admin credentials.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Authentication succeeds; user redirected to Admin Dashboard (/admin/dashboard) with full administrative rights.

test_cases.desc: Login with incorrect password
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter registered email.
2. Enter wrong password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 400/401 with error message: 'Sai email hoặc mật khẩu'. User remains on login screen.

test_cases.desc: Login with non-existent email
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter unregistered email (e.g. unknown_user_999@example.com).
2. Enter any password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 400/401 with generic error: 'Sai email hoặc mật khẩu' (prevents account enumeration attacks).
test_cases.pre: Email is not registered in system

test_cases.desc: Login with invalid email format
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter email format 'user_email_without_at.com' or 'test@'.
2. Enter password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Client-side validation error shown: 'Email không đúng định dạng'. Form submission is blocked.

test_cases.desc: Login with empty email and password fields
test_cases.proc:
1. Leave email and password blank.
2. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Validation errors displayed: 'Email không được để trống' and 'Mật khẩu không được để trống'.

test_cases.desc: Login with locked / inactive account
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter credentials of an account where isActive = false.
2. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: Server rejects request with message: 'Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa hoặc chưa kích hoạt'. Access denied.

test_cases.desc: Login with leading/trailing whitespaces in email input
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter email '  valid_owner@example.com  ' with extra spaces.
2. Enter correct password.
3. Click 'Đăng nhập'.
test_cases.expected: System auto-trims whitespace, successfully authenticates and redirects to dashboard.

name: Register
desc: Verify new account registration for Owner/Tenant roles, duplicate email check, password complexity validation, and account profile initialization.
pre: User does not have an account in the system with the target email

test_cases.desc: Register new Owner account with valid details
test_cases.proc:
1. Navigate to Register page (/register) or click 'Đăng ký'.
2. Select role 'Chủ kho (Owner)'.
3. Enter Full Name: 'Trần Văn Chủ Kho', Phone: '0912345678', Email: 'new_owner@example.com', Password: 'Password123@'.
4. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: Account created successfully in DB (HTTP 201 Created); welcome email dispatched via SMTP; user redirected to login with success toast.
test_cases.pre: Email is not registered in DB

test_cases.desc: Register new Tenant account with valid details
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Register modal.
2. Select role 'Người thuê (Tenant)'.
3. Fill valid Name, Phone, Email, and Password.
4. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: Tenant account created in DB; welcome notification triggered; user can log in with new credentials immediately.
test_cases.pre: Email is not registered in DB

test_cases.desc: Register with email that already exists in database
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter an email that is already registered.
2. Fill all other fields with valid data.
3. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with error: 'Email này đã được đăng ký trong hệ thống'.

test_cases.desc: Register with password shorter than 6 characters
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter password '12345' (5 characters).
2. Fill other fields.
3. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Mật khẩu phải có tối thiểu 6 ký tự'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Register with invalid Vietnamese phone number format
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter phone number '12345' or 'abcdef' or '012345678901'.
2. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ (phải bắt đầu bằng 0 và có 10 chữ số)'.

test_cases.desc: Register with password confirmation mismatch
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter Password: 'Password123@'.
2. Enter Confirm Password: 'Password456@'.
3. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: Client validation error shown: 'Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Register with all required fields left blank
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Register form.
2. Leave Name, Phone, Email, Password empty.
3. Click 'Đăng ký'.
test_cases.expected: All mandatory field errors displayed: 'Họ và tên không được để trống', 'Email không được để trống', 'Mật khẩu không được để trống'.

test_cases.desc: Register attempting unauthorized role injection (ROLE_ADMIN)
test_cases.proc:
1. Intercept registration API request.
2. Modify role payload parameter from 'TENANT' to 'ADMIN'.
3. Send request to /api/auth/register.
test_cases.expected: Server DTO validation rejects with HTTP 400 Bad Request: only OWNER and TENANT roles are allowed for public registration.

test_cases.desc: Register with special characters or XSS script in Full Name
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter Full Name: '<script>alert("xss")</script> Nguyễn Văn A'.
2. Submit registration.
test_cases.expected: Server/Client sanitizes input safely; user created with escaped name string, preventing script execution.

name: Google OAuth Login
desc: Verify authenticating or onboarding via Google OAuth2 with server-side authorization code exchange.
pre: User has an active Google account

test_cases.desc: Sign in with Google account (First-time user onboarding)
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google' button.
2. Select Google account and authorize permissions.
3. Google returns authorization code to frontend callback.
4. FE calls /api/auth/google with code and role.
test_cases.expected: Backend verifies token with Google OAuth API; creates new user in DB with provider GOOGLE; issues JWT tokens and redirects to dashboard.
test_cases.pre: Google account not previously registered in StockSpace

test_cases.desc: Sign in with Google account (Returning existing user)
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Authorize with previously registered Google account.
test_cases.expected: System matches existing user record; issues JWT access/refresh tokens; redirects to role dashboard without duplicate account creation.
test_cases.pre: User has existing account with provider GOOGLE

test_cases.desc: Google OAuth popup cancelled by user
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Close or dismiss the Google OAuth consent popup window.
test_cases.expected: Popup closes gracefully; login modal remains active; no uncaught exceptions in console; user can choose alternate login method.

test_cases.desc: Google OAuth with invalid or expired authorization code
test_cases.proc: 1. Send manipulated or expired authorization code to /api/auth/google.
test_cases.expected: Server rejects with HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'Mã xác thực Google không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn'.

test_cases.desc: Google OAuth when corresponding local account is locked
test_cases.proc:
1. User previously registered via Google, but account isActive was set to false by Admin.
2. User attempts Google sign in.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 403 Forbidden: 'Tài khoản của bạn đã bị khóa hoặc chưa kích hoạt'.

name: Forget Password
desc: Verify requesting password reset link via email, generating secure reset token and sending SMTP email.
pre: User has an account with a registered email

test_cases.desc: Request password reset with valid registered email
test_cases.proc:
1. Navigate to /forgot-password.
2. Enter registered email address.
3. Click 'Gửi yêu cầu'.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 200 OK; generates secure 48h reset token; dispatches reset email via SMTP; displays success message.
test_cases.pre: User account exists with verified email

test_cases.desc: Request password reset with unregistered email
test_cases.proc:
1. Open /forgot-password.
2. Enter non-existent email address (e.g. not_found_99@gmail.com).
3. Click 'Gửi yêu cầu'.
test_cases.expected: System displays safe generic message: 'Nếu email tồn tại trong hệ thống, chúng tôi đã gửi đường dẫn...'; no email dispatched; prevents account probing.
test_cases.pre: Email does not exist in DB

test_cases.desc: Request password reset with invalid email format
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter 'invalid-email-string' in email field.
2. Click 'Gửi yêu cầu'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Email không đúng định dạng'. Request blocked.

test_cases.desc: Request password reset with empty email field
test_cases.proc:
1. Leave email field empty.
2. Click 'Gửi yêu cầu'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Vui lòng nhập địa chỉ email'.

test_cases.desc: Spam multiple consecutive reset password requests
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter valid email.
2. Click 'Gửi yêu cầu' repeatedly 5 times in 10 seconds.
test_cases.expected: System handles rate limiting / updates token safely; only the most recently generated reset token remains valid.

name: Reset Password
desc: Verify updating account password using token from reset email, validating token validity and expiry window.
pre: User holds a valid non-expired password reset token

test_cases.desc: Reset password successfully with valid token and strong new password
test_cases.proc:
1. Open link /reset-password?token={valid_token}.
2. Enter new password: 'NewSecurePassword123@'.
3. Enter confirm password: 'NewSecurePassword123@'.
4. Click 'Đặt lại mật khẩu'.
test_cases.expected: Password updated in DB with BCrypt hash; old password invalidated; reset token revoked; user redirected to login with success notification.
test_cases.pre: Reset token is valid and within 48h expiration window

test_cases.desc: Reset password with expired token (> 48 hours)
test_cases.proc:
1. Access reset URL with a token created more than 48 hours ago.
2. Enter valid new password.
3. Click 'Đặt lại mật khẩu'.
test_cases.expected: System displays error: 'Đường dẫn đặt lại mật khẩu đã hết hạn hoặc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng yêu cầu lại'. Password unchanged.

test_cases.desc: Reset password with invalid or tampered token string
test_cases.proc:
1. Access /reset-password?token=invalid_fake_token_123.
2. Enter new password and submit.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with error: 'Mã token không hợp lệ'.

test_cases.desc: Reset password with new password shorter than 6 characters
test_cases.proc:
1. Access valid reset URL.
2. Enter password '123' (3 chars).
3. Submit form.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Mật khẩu phải có tối thiểu 6 ký tự'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Reset password with mismatched password confirmation
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter New Password: 'PasswordA@123'.
2. Enter Confirm Password: 'PasswordB@456'.
3. Submit form.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Attempt to reuse an already-used reset token
test_cases.proc:
1. Successfully reset password using token once.
2. Try to reuse the exact same token URL again to change password a second time.
test_cases.expected: Server rejects request: token is already marked as consumed/invalid. Password cannot be reset again with same token.

name: View and Update Profile
desc: Verify retrieving current logged-in user details and updating full name, phone number, and avatar URL.
pre: User is authenticated with valid JWT token

test_cases.desc: View authenticated user profile details
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in to system.
2. Navigate to Profile page (/profile).
3. Inspect displayed fields.
test_cases.expected: System calls GET /api/auth/me; displays Full Name, Email, Phone, Role badge, Provider (LOCAL/GOOGLE), and Avatar.

test_cases.desc: Update profile details with valid new information
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Profile page.
2. Change Full Name to 'Nguyễn Văn Đạt'.
3. Change Phone to '0987654321'.
4. Change Avatar URL to valid image link.
5. Click 'Lưu thay đổi'.
test_cases.expected: System calls PUT /api/auth/me; DB record updated; success toast: 'Cập nhật thông tin thành công'; UI header updates new avatar/name.

test_cases.desc: Update profile with invalid phone number format
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter phone number '123' or 'abcd' or special chars.
2. Click 'Lưu thay đổi'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Số điện thoại không hợp lệ'. API call blocked.

test_cases.desc: Update profile with empty Full Name
test_cases.proc:
1. Clear the Full Name field.
2. Click 'Lưu thay đổi'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Họ và tên không được để trống'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Attempt to modify non-editable fields (Email, Role, Balance)
test_cases.proc:
1. Inspect profile form.
2. Verify Email and Role fields are disabled / read-only.
3. Intercept PUT /api/auth/me and inject modified 'email' or 'role' in JSON.
test_cases.expected: Backend DTO ignores injected email/role; only allowed profile fields (fullName, phone, avatarUrl) are updated.

test_cases.desc: Access profile page when unauthenticated (Expired or missing JWT)
test_cases.proc:
1. Clear auth cookies/token.
2. Directly navigate to URL /profile.
test_cases.expected: RoleGuard intercepts request; redirects user to Login page or displays Unauthorized error.

name: Create Warehouse
desc: Verify warehouse listing creation by Owner with complete details (specifications, dimensions, storage type, rental rates, policies, and photos).
pre: User logged in with Owner role

test_cases.desc: Owner creates a new warehouse with valid info
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Owner.
2. Navigate to 'Đăng kho' (/owner/postwarehouse).
3. Enter Warehouse Name: 'Kho Tiêu Chuẩn Sài Gòn 1', Address: 'Khu công nghiệp Tân Bình, TP.HCM', Category: 'Kho tổng hợp'.
4. Enter dimensions: Width 30m, Length 50m, Height 8m, Price: 45,000,000 VND/tháng.
5. Upload warehouse certificates and photos.
6. Click 'Đăng kho'.
test_cases.expected: Warehouse is created successfully; status is PENDING_APPROVAL; system prompts Owner to configure default 2D/3D layout.

test_cases.desc: Create warehouse with missing name
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Owner.
2. Open Post Warehouse form.
3. Fill all fields but leave Warehouse Name empty.
4. Click 'Đăng kho'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error message shown: 'Tên kho không được để trống'. Form submission blocked.

test_cases.desc: Create warehouse with negative price
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter Price: -5,000,000.
2. Fill other valid fields.
3. Click 'Đăng kho'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error message shown: 'Giá thuê phải lớn hơn 0' (Price must be positive).

test_cases.desc: Create warehouse with missing pricePerMonth
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Owner.
2. Leave 'Giá thuê theo tháng' field blank.
3. Click 'Đăng kho'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error message shown: 'Giá thuê không được để trống' (Price cannot be empty).

test_cases.desc: Create warehouse with invalid dimensions (Width <= 0 or Length <= 0)
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter Width: 0, Length: -10, Height: 6.
2. Click 'Đăng kho'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error shown: 'Kích thước chiều rộng và chiều dài phải lớn hơn 0'.

name: Update Warehouse Information
desc: Verify Owner modifying warehouse amenities, description, and contact info while preserving verified status.
pre: User is Owner of the warehouse

test_cases.desc: Owner updates warehouse description and amenities
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Owner Warehouse list (/owner/listwarehouse).
2. Click 'Chỉnh sửa' on a warehouse.
3. Update description and toggle CCTV/Forklift amenities.
4. Click 'Lưu thay đổi'.
test_cases.expected: Warehouse info updated successfully in database; changes immediately visible on warehouse detail page.

test_cases.desc: Attempt to update a warehouse owned by another owner
test_cases.proc:
1. Owner A captures warehouseId belonging to Owner B.
2. Owner A sends PUT /api/owner/warehouses/{id} with modified payload.
test_cases.expected: Server rejects with HTTP 403 Forbidden: 'Bạn không có quyền chỉnh sửa kho hàng này' (WAREHOUSE_NOT_OWNED).
test_cases.pre: Warehouse is owned by a different user

test_cases.desc: Update warehouse with empty address
test_cases.proc:
1. Clear the warehouse address field.
2. Click 'Lưu thay đổi'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Địa chỉ kho không được để trống'. Update rejected.

name: Search Warehouses
desc: Verify public warehouse search with multi-criteria filters (province, price range, area, storage type, keyword).
pre: System contains active, published warehouses

test_cases.desc: Public user searches warehouses with matching filter
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to public Warehouse Marketplace (/warehouses).
2. Enter keyword 'Kho tiêu chuẩn'.
3. Select Province 'Hồ Chí Minh' and Price range '30 - 60 triệu'.
4. Apply filter.
test_cases.expected: System returns list of AVAILABLE published warehouses matching criteria with accurate pagination.
test_cases.pre: System has at least one published warehouse matching criteria

test_cases.desc: Public user searches with no matching results
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter keyword 'NonExistentWarehouseString999'.
2. Select Province 'Cà Mau'.
3. Apply filter.
test_cases.expected: System returns empty list and displays friendly message: 'Không tìm thấy kho hàng phù hợp với bộ lọc'.

test_cases.desc: Filter warehouses by storage category type
test_cases.proc:
1. Select Category: 'Kho lạnh (Cold Storage)'.
2. Apply filter.
test_cases.expected: Only warehouses classified under cold storage category are returned.
test_cases.pre: Cold storage warehouses exist in system

test_cases.desc: Sort warehouses by Price Low to High and Area High to Low
test_cases.proc:
1. Open /warehouses.
2. Select Sort by: 'Giá tăng dần'.
3. Change to 'Diện tích giảm dần'.
test_cases.expected: Warehouse cards reorder smoothly matching the selected sorting criteria.

name: View Warehouse Details
desc: Verify public visitors viewing full warehouse specifications, inspection rating scores, owner info, and 3D layout tour.
pre: Target warehouse exists and is published

test_cases.desc: View public warehouse detail page with 3D scene
test_cases.proc:
1. Click on warehouse card from listing.
2. Inspect specs (Dimensions, Total area, Clear height, Floor load).
3. Inspect fire safety certificate, inspection badge, and 3D layout viewer.
test_cases.expected: Full warehouse specs load; Three.js 3D layout renders interactive zones and racks; Owner contact card displayed.

test_cases.desc: View non-existent warehouse detail page (Invalid UUID)
test_cases.expected: System shows 404 Not Found error: 'Kho hàng không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng hoạt động'; user offered button to return to listing.

test_cases.desc: Public user views an unverified / draft warehouse detail
test_cases.proc: 1. Attempt to view URL of a warehouse in DRAFT or REJECTED status as a public guest.
test_cases.expected: System restricts access: only published, verified warehouses are publicly viewable.

name: Verify/Reject Warehouse (Admin)
desc: Verify Admin approving or rejecting a submitted warehouse listing after reviewing documents and layout.
pre: User is Admin, target warehouse is in PENDING_APPROVAL status

test_cases.desc: Admin approves (verifies) a pending warehouse
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Admin.
2. Navigate to Warehouse Approvals (/admin/listings).
3. Open pending warehouse listing.
4. Review legal documents and specifications.
5. Click 'Phê duyệt'.
test_cases.expected: Success message 'Duyệt kho thành công' is shown; warehouse status changes to VERIFIED; Owner receives approval notification.
test_cases.pre: User is Admin, warehouse status is PENDING_APPROVAL

test_cases.desc: Admin approves warehouse with invalid or non-existent ID
test_cases.proc:
1. Manually trigger approval API with non-existent warehouseId.
2. Submit request.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 404 Not Found: 'Kho hàng không tồn tại'. Action blocked.

test_cases.desc: Admin rejects pending warehouse with reason
test_cases.proc:
1. In pending approval list, click 'Từ chối'.
2. Enter rejection reason: 'Hồ sơ PCCC chưa đủ dấu thẩm duyệt của cơ quan chức năng'.
3. Confirm rejection.
test_cases.expected: Success message 'Từ chối duyệt kho thành công' is shown; warehouse status changes to REJECTED; reason recorded in audit log and sent to Owner.
test_cases.pre: User is Admin, warehouse status is PENDING_APPROVAL

test_cases.desc: Admin rejects warehouse without entering rejection reason
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Từ chối'.
2. Leave reason box blank.
3. Click confirm.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối để thông báo cho chủ kho'. Action blocked.

name: Save Owner Warehouse Layout
desc: Verify Owner designing and bulk saving default 2D/3D layout structure (zones, racks, shelves, and storage bins).
pre: User is Owner of warehouse, warehouse exists

test_cases.desc: Owner saves default 2D/3D layout structure with zones, racks, and bins
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Owner.
2. Open 3D Layout Designer for warehouse.
3. Add Zone A (General Storage), 4 Racks, and 16 Bins.
4. Configure dimensions and load capacities.
5. Click 'Lưu sơ đồ kho'.
test_cases.expected: Success message 'Lưu sơ đồ kho thành công' is shown; layout hierarchy saved in DB; total volume synchronized.
test_cases.pre: User is Owner, warehouse exists in system

test_cases.desc: Owner saves layout with coordinates exceeding warehouse physical boundary
test_cases.proc:
1. In 3D designer, place a rack at X=45m when warehouse width is only 30m.
2. Click 'Lưu sơ đồ kho'.
test_cases.expected: System rejects with validation error: 'Tọa độ/Kích thước giá kệ vượt quá kích thước vật lý của kho'.

test_cases.desc: Owner saves layout with overlapping racks
test_cases.proc:
1. Place Rack 2 directly overlapping Rack 1 on same coordinates.
2. Click Save.
test_cases.expected: 3D visual alert indicates collision/overlap; validation blocks saving until racks are separated.

name: Get Owner Warehouse Layout
desc: Verify retrieving default 2D/3D layout tree structure configured by warehouse owner.
pre: User is Owner of warehouse

test_cases.desc: Owner loads default warehouse layout tree
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Layout Warehouse page for owned warehouse.
2. Observe 3D canvas and zone tree hierarchy.
test_cases.expected: System returns WarehouseLayoutResponse; 3D viewport renders all zones, racks, shelves, and bins accurately.

test_cases.desc: Owner loads layout for warehouse without prior layout
test_cases.proc:
1. Open Layout page for newly created warehouse.
2. System detects empty layout.
test_cases.expected: 3D canvas displays empty floor with perimeter grid; prompts user to generate initial layout or place zones.

name: Save Tenant Snapshot Layout
desc: Verify Tenant customizing their operational rack and bin layout clone for rented warehouse.
pre: User is Tenant with active contract for target warehouse

test_cases.desc: Tenant saves customized snapshot layout clone
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Tenant.
2. Navigate to /tenant/layoutwarehouses.
3. Customize bin codes and zone labels for operations.
4. Click 'Lưu sơ đồ thuê'.
test_cases.expected: Tenant snapshot layout saved; changes isolated to tenant's contract without modifying Owner's master template.
test_cases.pre: Active lease contract exists for warehouse

test_cases.desc: Tenant attempts to save layout when contract is not ACTIVE
test_cases.proc: 1. Attempt to save layout modifications for a contract in DRAFT or EXPIRED status.
test_cases.expected: Server rejects with HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'Hợp đồng chưa được kích hoạt hoặc đã hết hạn'.

name: Get Tenant / Staff Layout
desc: Verify Tenant and assigned Staff loading tenant-specific 2D/3D warehouse layout snapshot.
pre: User is Tenant or assigned Staff with active contract

test_cases.desc: Assigned Staff loads warehouse operational layout
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Staff.
2. Open /staff/layoutwarehouses.
3. Select assigned warehouse.
test_cases.expected: Staff loads tenant operational layout clone; bins color-coded by stock occupancy; read-only mode enforced.

test_cases.desc: Unassigned Staff attempts to view warehouse layout
test_cases.proc: 1. Staff attempts to access layout of warehouseId they are not assigned to.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 403 Forbidden: 'Bạn không có quyền truy cập sơ đồ kho hàng này'.
test_cases.pre: Staff is not assigned to target warehouse

name: View Storage Load & Capacity
